WITH /* 기준 운항 원천 */ FLT_SRC AS ( SELECT A.DOM_INTL_SE_CD , A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD , A.TMNL_ID , A.ALN_CD , A.FLTNM , A.FLTSH_ID , A.GD_SE_YMD , A.SCHDL_HM , TRIM(A.PREDC_HM) AS PREDC_HM , TRIM(A.ACTL_HM) AS ACTL_HM , A.ARPT_CD , NULLIF(A.ACST_NO, '0000') AS SRC_ACST_NO , A.GATE_NO AS SRC_GATE_NO , NULLIF(TRIM(A.CRSL_NO), '0') AS SRC_CRSL_NO , A.ARCFT_SUBTYPE_CD , A.GD_IRR_YN , TO_NUMBER(A.ARCFT_STGCP) AS ARCFT_STGCP , TO_NUMBER(A.PFR_BRDG_TNOPE) + TO_NUMBER(A.FREE_BRDG_TNOPE) + TO_NUMBER(A.TRNS_BRDG_TNOPE) AS BRDG_BDPSG_CNT , TO_NUMBER(A.TRNS_BRDG_TNOPE) AS BRDG_TRNS_BDPSG_CNT , TO_NUMBER(A.RSVT_BDPSG_CNT) AS RSVT_BDPSG_CNT , TO_NUMBER(A.RSVT_TRNS_BDPSG_CNT) AS RSVT_TRNS_BDPSG_CNT , TO_DATE(A.GD_SE_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD') AS GD_DT , TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(A.SCHDL_HM, 1, 2)) * 60 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(A.SCHDL_HM, 3, 2)) AS SCHDL_MIN , TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(A.PREDC_HM), 1, 2)) * 60 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(A.PREDC_HM), 3, 2)) AS PREDC_MIN , TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(A.ACTL_HM), 1, 2)) * 60 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(A.ACTL_HM), 3, 2)) AS ACTL_MIN FROM GOOWN.TN_GO_GD_DATA A WHERE A.GD_SE_YMD = #{fsYmd} AND A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'D'
), /* 기준 운항 + 터미널 그룹(P02 탑승동은 P01) · 시각 · 여객수 */ FLT AS ( SELECT S.* , CASE WHEN S.TMNL_ID = 'P02' THEN 'P01' ELSE S.TMNL_ID END AS TMNL_GRP_ID , SUBSTR(S.GD_SE_YMD, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(S.GD_SE_YMD, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(S.GD_SE_YMD, 7, 2) || 'T' || SUBSTR(S.SCHDL_HM, 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(S.SCHDL_HM, 3, 2) || ':00.000' AS SCHDL_TIME , S.GD_DT + S.SCHDL_MIN / 1440 AS SCHDL_DT /* 계획보다 12시간 넘게 이른 예측 · 실제 시각은 자정을 넘긴 다음 날로 본다 */ , S.GD_DT + (S.PREDC_MIN + CASE WHEN S.PREDC_MIN < S.SCHDL_MIN - 720 THEN 1440 ELSE 0 END) / 1440 AS PREDC_DT , S.GD_DT + (S.ACTL_MIN + CASE WHEN S.ACTL_MIN < S.SCHDL_MIN - 720 THEN 1440 ELSE 0 END) / 1440 AS ACTL_DT , CASE WHEN S.BRDG_BDPSG_CNT > 0 THEN S.BRDG_BDPSG_CNT ELSE S.RSVT_BDPSG_CNT END AS BDPSG_CNT , CASE WHEN S.BRDG_BDPSG_CNT > 0 THEN S.BRDG_TRNS_BDPSG_CNT ELSE S.RSVT_TRNS_BDPSG_CNT END AS TRNS_BDPSG_CNT FROM FLT_SRC S ), /* 편별 체크인카운터 범위(D01-D18) - 아일랜드가 갈리면 카운터가 많은 아일랜드 하나 */ CKNCT_RANGE AS ( /* 순위 = 카운터 수 많은 아일랜드 → 아일랜드 이름. 1순위 아일랜드의 처음 · 끝 카운터 */ SELECT G.FLTSH_ID , MIN(G.MIN_CKNCT_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY G.CKNCT_CNT DESC, G.ISLAND) || '-' || MAX(G.MAX_CKNCT_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY G.CKNCT_CNT DESC, G.ISLAND) AS CKNCT_RANGE_CN FROM ( /* 편별 배정 카운터 - 출발 기준 시각 −3시간 ~ −1시간과 겹치는 같은 터미널의 항공사(C) 배정 (gdDataChknAlotCond 와 같은 판정) */ SELECT F.FLTSH_ID , SUBSTR(AL.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) AS ISLAND , COUNT(DISTINCT AL.CKNCT_ID) AS CKNCT_CNT , MIN(AL.CKNCT_ID) AS MIN_CKNCT_ID , MAX(AL.CKNCT_ID) AS MAX_CKNCT_ID FROM ( SELECT FLTSH_ID , ALN_CD , TMNL_GRP_ID , NVL(PREDC_DT, SCHDL_DT) - 180 / 1440 AS CHKN_BGN_DT , NVL(PREDC_DT, SCHDL_DT) - 60 / 1440 AS CHKN_END_DT FROM FLT WHERE ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'D' AND FLTSH_ID IS NOT NULL ) F /* 체크인카운터 배정 - CA001 과 같은 원천 · 필터 */ JOIN () AL ON AL.TMNL_ID = F.TMNL_GRP_ID AND AL.ALN_CD = F.ALN_CD AND AL.CHKN_TYPE_CD = 'C' AND AL.BGN_DT < F.CHKN_END_DT AND AL.END_DT > F.CHKN_BGN_DT GROUP BY F.FLTSH_ID, SUBSTR(AL.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) ) G GROUP BY G.FLTSH_ID ), /* 최근 3개월 기준 편명 · 출도착 · 터미널 그룹별 대표 주기장 · 게이트 */ PAST_GATE AS ( SELECT FLTNM, ARR_DEP_SE_CD, TMNL_GRP_ID, ACST_NO, GATE_NO FROM ( SELECT P.FLTNM , P.ARR_DEP_SE_CD , P.TMNL_GRP_ID , P.ACST_NO , P.GATE_NO , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY P.FLTNM, P.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, P.TMNL_GRP_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(P.GD_SE_YMD) DESC, P.GATE_NO, P.ACST_NO ) AS RN FROM ( SELECT A.FLTNM , A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD , CASE WHEN A.TMNL_ID = 'P02' THEN 'P01' ELSE A.TMNL_ID END AS TMNL_GRP_ID , A.ACST_NO , A.GATE_NO , A.GD_SE_YMD FROM GOOWN.TN_GO_GD_DATA A WHERE A.GD_SE_YMD BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD'), - 3), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
AND A.ACST_NO != '0000' AND A.GATE_NO IS NOT NULL ) P GROUP BY P.FLTNM, P.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, P.TMNL_GRP_ID, P.ACST_NO, P.GATE_NO ) WHERE RN = 1 ), /* RS 캐로셀 정보 */ DALY_CRSL AS ( SELECT ARR_DALY_FLTSH_ID AS FLTSH_ID , MIN(NULLIF(CRSL_NO, '0')) AS CRSL_NO FROM GOOWN.TI_GO_CRSL_DALY_OPER WHERE ALTMNT_YMD BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY ARR_DALY_FLTSH_ID ), /* 최근 1개월 도착편 기준 대표 캐로셀 */ PAST_CRSL AS ( SELECT FLTNM, GATE_NO, ACST_NO, CRSL_NO FROM ( SELECT A.FLTNM , A.GATE_NO , A.ACST_NO , A.CRSL_NO , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.FLTNM, A.GATE_NO, A.ACST_NO ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(A.GD_SE_YMD) DESC, A.CRSL_NO ) AS RN FROM GOOWN.TN_GO_GD_DATA A WHERE A.GD_SE_YMD BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD'), - 1), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'A'
